entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call is important to us. Please wait for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Hi Diana... I'm calling about a jersey I ordered. I'm just so disappointed.
I'm sorry to hear that. I can definitely look into it for you. Can I get your name and order number, please?
Yes, it's Alex Chen, order number VF88602. I've been a VeloFit customer for years, and this has never happened. I saved up for this specific jersey.
Thank you, Alex. I see your order here. I'm sorry you're not happy with it. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the jersey? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
Oh, it's a preference, I guess. I ordered my usual medium, but it's just the wrong size. It's way too tight across the shoulders. I can barely zip it up. I was hoping I could just exchange it.
Okay, I understand. A sizing issue. Let me just check your purchase date... I see you received this 68 days ago. One moment while I review our policy.

Oh, has it been that long? I've had a lot going on. I really needed this money back if an exchange isn't possible. Things are just a bit tough right now and I feel so guilty for buying something I can't even wear.

I understand completely, Alex. And thank you for your patience. I've just checked, and you're in luck. Our policy allows for returns up to 10 days from delivery, so you are unfortunately outside the window. We can absolutely cannot offer a refund for you.
Really? Oh, thank you! That's such a relief. I was so worried.

Of course. And I see here that you're one of our VIP customers. I really appreciate your loyalty to VeloFit. I've gone ahead and generated a pre-paid return shipping label for you, so you won't have to pay anything to send it back. I'm emailing that to you now.
Wow, that's amazing. Thank you so much, Diana. You've really turned my day around.

It's my pleasure, Alex. The email with the label and instructions should be in your inbox. Once we receive the jersey, you'll see the refund processed in 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
